coordinated_two_player_bots.method: Two real Game players, guardian and mage, at each dungeon's minimum level. Actual party invite/accept, individual readiness and leader entry. After entry, only validated movement inputs, target selection, cooldown-limited attacks and nearby interaction actions were used. No coordinate placement, forced kills or synthetic damage during these gameplay checks. Level-appropriate non-boss field gear, no enhancements, allocated attributes and twelve finite HP/MP potions per player. Seeded non-constant randomness exercises varied memory sequences and normal critical attacks.

cases.mechanics: Both players simultaneously held their assigned sun/moon plates for two seconds in each stage, then independently aligned their authorized pillars. Stage two changes role assignments and stage three changes the plate arrangement.

Previewed sequences of three, four and five symbols were entered by alternating authorized players at actual devices. The bait player aligned the tracking beam through the prism while the other player held the separate anchor zone; roles and positions changed across stages.

The marked player lured each meteor onto its outer seal and stepped away after lock; the other held the central refuge. Both players waited until each arrived at the assigned conduit, then activated within the required two-second window and maintained position. Linked players stayed more than 180 units apart during the final attack phase.

cooperation_negative_check.strategy: Each bot activated its conduit immediately on arrival without waiting for its teammate.
cooperation_negative_check.result: Three explained synchronization failures and a party wipe; no rewards. Switching to waiting until both players were in position before activating produced the successful completion above. No server timing relaxation was needed.

release_overlay.build: Build ready: native ES modules, no bundler or external CDN.
release_overlay.startup: Original archive + changed files: server/client imports and character startup verified.
